strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Build a personal weak-network VPN for OpenWrt/Linux to Linux or Windows using unordered FakeTCP/FEC carriers plus a native standards-compliant DTLS 1.3 WBD security/session layer. Xray/VLESS/Vision/REALITY, WireGuard and Android are not part of the V2.1 product stack.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: V2-M3 native WBD session/control inside the locally qualified one-lane DTLS/FEC/FakeTCP path; M3A framing, M3B token auth, M3C liveness/stats and M3D close/reconnect policy passed, M3E fixed-mode config negotiation active
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Keep all M3 semantics inside an already-finished DTLS 1.3 association. Do not invent another cryptographic layer, reliable public byte stream or custom FEC. Do not start two-lane, kernel-anchor, TUN/L3, Windows, Auto or detector-specific shaping work before the M3 session/control gate passes. M3E may negotiate only the constitution-defined fixed protection modes normal, weak-1.5x and weak-2x; Auto remains deferred.

continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: Completed V2-M3D through substantive commit 529dce12646aeba74bc2dd0b15c9f68b50ec9ad7. The independent WBDC control codec adds bounded CLOSE type 8 with enumerated reasons normal, idle-timeout, auth-failure, policy, protocol-error and transient-transport plus <=256-byte UTF-8 detail. ServerSession accepts peer CLOSE only after Established, echoes it, records the close reason and enters Closed; caller-driven idle expiry can close an Established session with the idle-timeout reason. ReconnectAllowed permits retry only for idle-timeout and transient-transport; normal/auth/policy/protocol/unknown closes are non-retriable. Backoff(attempt,min,max) is a pure saturating exponential helper: no goroutine, sleep or replay, with invalid range and overflow boundary tests. Local direct-DTLS authority used the M2-qualified quiet shim SHA-256 63329b8528196159f430bb89bf40b98e52ed74073f57ed81d068cddb55e50d7a and started WBD control only after both peers reported DTLSv1.3 / TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 READY. The qualified sequence HELLO/ACCEPT -> AUTH/AUTH_OK -> PING/PONG -> CLOSE/CLOSE-echo ended with server state Closed and close reason normal. docs/protocol/v2-m3d-receipt.json records result=pass, server rx=4 tx=4, pings=1 pongs=1, auth_required/authenticated=true and close_reason=1. GitHub ci run 32765924791, handoff-verify 32765924976 and build-quic-oracle 32765924836 all completed successfully for 529dce12646aeba74bc2dd0b15c9f68b50ec9ad7.
continuation_cursor.current_task: V2-M3E: add one-time fixed protection-mode configuration inside an already-Established WBD session. Negotiate only the constitution-defined normal, weak-1.5x and weak-2x modes; explicitly reject auto and unknown values. Record selected mode/configured state without dynamically changing UDPspeeder or carrier behavior in this gate.
continuation_cursor.why_now: M3 has strict framing, authorization, liveness/accounting and deterministic termination/retry policy. Before the session/control milestone can close, the peer must have one explicit product-mode decision that later TUN/data-plane code can require before forwarding traffic. Keeping this as a one-time Established-state CONFIG avoids smuggling old V1 RBC/lane semantics back into the protocol.
continuation_cursor.done_when: M3E defines strict CONFIG and CONFIG_OK frames for exactly normal, weak-1.5x and weak-2x; auto/zero/unknown modes are rejected; ServerSession accepts CONFIG only once in Established, records Configured=true and ProtectionMode in stats without changing carrier/FEC processes; duplicate or pre-auth/pre-HELLO CONFIG is rejected deterministically; unit/malformed tests cover codec/state/mode policy; and a direct-DTLS loopback demonstrates token-authenticated Established -> CONFIG weak-1.5x -> CONFIG_OK with server stats recording the mode. No actual UDPspeeder reconfiguration, TUN forwarding, two-lane or Auto work is part of M3E.
